items.exampleEn: I get a lot of unwanted emails every day.
items.exampleZh: 我每天都收到很多不想要的電子郵件。

items.exampleEn: A brightly lit shop window caught my eye.
items.exampleZh: 一扇燈火明亮的商店櫥窗吸引了我的目光。
他間接地回答了我的問題。

items.exampleEn: He accidentally stepped on my foot.
Her handwriting is small and graceful.
It is incorrect to say that all birds can fly.
items.exampleZh: 說所有的鳥都會飛是不正確的。

items.exampleEn: The discovery was accidental: he was looking for something else.
items.exampleZh: 這個發現是偶然的：他本來在找別的東西。

items.exampleEn: His story was unrelated to our topic.
items.exampleZh: 他的故事和我們的主題無關。

items.sentenceEn: Sorry, I accidentally took your umbrella.
items.sentenceZh: 抱歉，我不小心拿了你的雨傘。

items.audioEn: Your phone number on the form is incorrect. Please write it again.
items.audioZh: 你表格上的電話號碼不正確，請再寫一次。
options: Bring the form back next Monday.
Call the office before five o'clock.

items.sentenceEn: The room was brightly painted in yellow.
items.sentenceZh: 房間被漆成鮮豔的黃色。
這兩個問題看起來無關。

items.stemEn: I ____ sent the message to the wrong person.
items.stemZh: 我不小心把訊息傳給了錯的人。

items.stemEn: The tall bird looked very ____ as it walked in the water.
items.stemZh: 那隻高高的鳥在水中走路的樣子非常優雅。

items.passageEn: Last Saturday, our school held a sale of unwanted things. The sun was shining brightly, and many people came. I sold my old toys. One woman accidentally broke a cup, but she said sorry and paid for it. The teacher said it was accidental, so it was no problem. A girl from my class did a graceful dance to bring in more people. At first, I wrote incorrect prices on some things, so my friend helped me fix them. The money will go to a charity that builds libraries, so the sale will indirectly help many children. One man asked me some unrelated questions, like what my favorite subject was.
items.passageZh: 上週六，我們學校舉辦了一場義賣，賣大家不想要的東西。陽光明亮地照耀著，來了很多人。我賣了我的舊玩具。一位女士不小心打破了一個杯子，但她道了歉並付了錢。老師說那只是意外，沒關係。我們班一位女生跳了一段優雅的舞來吸引更多人。一開始，我把一些東西的價格寫錯了，所以朋友幫我改正。賣得的錢會捐給一個蓋圖書館的慈善機構，所以這場義賣會間接幫助很多孩子。有一位先生問了我一些無關的問題，像是我最喜歡哪個科目。

questions.questionZh: 那位女士打破杯子後怎麼做？
options: 請老師再拿一個新杯子給她
幫學校買一台新的電腦和投影機
給全班同學辦一場畢業旅行
捐給蓋圖書館的慈善機構

items.promptZh: 我覺得這個答案不正確。
referenceEn: I think this answer is incorrect.
I think the answer is incorrect.
rubricZh: incorrect 表示「不正確的」，例如 an incorrect answer 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 graceful 造一個句子，描述一個優雅的人或動物。
referenceEn: My cat is very graceful when she jumps.
I think my dance teacher is graceful.
rubricZh: graceful 表示「優雅的」，例如 a graceful dancer 等說法
說的是自己的看法（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式；說過去的事用過去式等）
